note: The Marshall Islands: nationals of Micronesia, Palau and the United States enter without a visa for an unlimited period, Taiwanese for 90 days, the EU's and the UK's for 90 in 180; nationals of the countries listed get a free 90-day visa on arrival (with a police record and a health clearance); everyone else needs a visa beforehand. Kwajalein's US military entry authorisation isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Immigration Regulations of 2009, as the Judiciary publishes them: citizens of the United States, Palau and Micronesia need no visa (§5), citizens of the countries with which the Republic has diplomatic ties get a visitor visa on arrival for 90 days (§6; the list is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs', not reached), and everyone else needs a visa beforehand (§7). The Regulations predate the EU's, the UK's and Taiwan's exemptions, which stand on Wikipedia's copy, as does the list of countries with diplomatic ties.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Marshall Islands
sources.said: Visitors to the Marshall Islands must obtain a visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter the Marshall Islands without a visa for the following period: Unlimited period Micronesia Palau United States 90 days Taiwan 90 days within any 180 days All European Union member states United Kingdom ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a free visa on arrival for 90 days: Andorra Algeria Argentina Australia Azerbaijan Barbados Belize Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Brunei Cambodia Canada Cape Verde Chile Colombia Cook Islands Costa Rica Cuba Dominican Republic Ecuador Egypt El Salvador Eswatini Fiji French Polynesia Georgia Guatemala Honduras Iceland India Indonesia Israel Japan Kazakhstan Kiribati Kosovo Kuwait Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Liechtenstein Malaysia Maldives Mauritius Mexico Monaco Mongolia Morocco Myanmar Nauru New Caledonia New Zealand Nicaragua North Macedonia Papua New Guinea Paraguay Peru Philippines Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Sovereign Military Order of Malta Switzerland Tajikistan Thailand Timor-Leste Tonga Turkey Turkmenistan Tuvalu Ukraine United Arab Emirates Uruguay Vanuatu Vatican City Vietnam

sources.title: Republic of the Marshall Islands, Immigration Regulations of 2009 (published by the RMI Judiciary)
sources.said: §5. Persons Exempt from Visa Requirements. (1) The following persons shall be exempted from the requirement to hold a visa to enter the Republic: ... (c) a citizen of the United States; (d) a citizen of Palau or the Federated States of Micronesia; ... §6. Visa upon Arrival. (1) The following visas may be issued upon arrival: (a) Diplomatic Visas (including dependents); (b) Visitor Visas, to citizens of Countries which the Republic has diplomatic ties with. List of such countries are as provided by Ministry of Foreign Affairs from time to time. (2) Visitor Visas are valid for a period of ninety (90) days. ... §7. Requirement for Visa. Except as provided under Sections 5 and 6, citizens from all other countries must apply for visa prior to entering the Republic.
